verdict: Leads are efficient at $11.90 each; two open items need resolution now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 122 leads at a cost of $11.90 per lead — and cost per lead improved 26% week-over-week even as spend pulled back, meaning the budget that ran did so more efficiently. The lead volume dip this past week is modest (down roughly 9%) and tracks directly to lower daily spend, not a drop in ad performance. Two items are being addressed that matter for the full picture: phone-match attribution and CRM contact cleanup are both being completed so the scoreboard reflects every lead accurately. On the conversion side, leads are arriving but not consistently reaching scheduled appointments in the system — we're working through the intake flow to close that gap before the end-of-month decision point.
